arStrings.szText: And so it is through Akarat’s teachings, we find hope in this world of shadows! But Akarat’s words are not hope!
Giving a sermon, but stumbling through it. He's not very confident or good at this.
....that’s not what I meant to say. They are hope, they just also, I-I suppose, transcend hope.
